description: You are an industrial ecologist advising a regional utility company on their decarbonization roadmap. The utility is evaluating whether switching from coal-fired power to natural gas combined-cycle generation would meaningfully reduce their climate and acidification impacts. Using openLCA and the USLCI database at ~/LCA_Imports/uslci_database.zip (LCIA methods at ~/LCA_Imports/lcia_methods.zip), you must: (1) import the database and LCIA methods, (2) build separate product systems for coal electricity generation and natural gas electricity generation using relevant USLCI processes, (3) run LCIA calculations for both systems capturing at minimum Global Warming Potential (GWP) and Acidification Potential, (4) calculate the percentage reduction in GWP when switching from coal to natural gas, and (5) export the scenario comparison to ~/LCA_Results/electricity_scenarios.csv. The CSV must include both systems' GWP and Acidification impact values and the calculated percentage difference between them.
